title: Data and code for: Formal uncertainty budget for subducting hotspot-track reconstructions and trench-collision points along the Cenozoic Andean margin of Chile and Peru
description: Rotation models with nodal covariances, geochronological compilations, deposit and igneous-sample databases, and the Python code that reproduces every number, table and figure of the article submitted to Earth and Planetary Science Letters. Third-party datasets are not redistributed; THIRD_PARTY.md lists their sources and where the code expects them.
